test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 4 men and 6 women can complete a work in 8 days, while 3 men and 7 women can complete it in 10 days. In how many days will 25 women complete it?
solution:
**Given:**

(4 men + 6 women) can complete a work = 8 days

(3 men + 7 women) can complete a work = 10 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = efficiency × time

**Calculation:**

⇒ (4 men + 6 women) × 8 = (3 men + 7 women) × 10
